  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Through the Nesi'im explaining that Atik relates to the lower man, additional power is given to each person to connect to Atik and all its levels, including its innermost aspect.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">9)</t>
    <t s="1">And one may add,</t>
    <t s="2">that through this, that the Nesi'im and including the Rebbe, my father-in-law, the Baal HaHilula, wrote and explained the aforementioned matters so that it would be understood that the concept of Atik pertains to the lower man,</t>
    <t s="3">behold, through this there is an additional increase in the granting of power to each and every one, that he should have a connection to the concept of Atik,</t>
    <t s="4">and to all the levels within it,</t>
    <t s="5">until the innermost aspect of Atik.</t>
    <t s="6">And particularly according to what is known regarding the Alter Rebbe47,</t>
    <t s="7">from this it is understood that so it is with the Nesi'im who came after him,</t>
    <t s="8">those who filled his place,</t>
    <t s="9">that at the time he spoke or wrote about some matter and level,</t>
    <t s="10">behold, not only was he himself in that state at that time,</t>
    <t s="11">but he also effected this upon the Chassidim.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">

    <t s="8">And the Alter Rebbe explained50,</t>

    <t s="15">And behold, from the language of the Maggid "that everything that is above, all of it is from you," it is understood that this applies not only regarding the Sefiros but also regarding Atik</t>

    <t s="25">but also the matters before the tzimtzum,</t>

    <t s="29">And in the language of the Rambam51,</t>

    <t s="38">And the manner of their coming into being from Atzmus is through the service of man.</t>
    <t s="39">And the reason for this is,</t>

    <t s="42">(and they have no ascent from their own accord),</t>

    <t s="44">than which there is no lower beneath it,</t>
    <t s="45">that specifically in it</t>
    <t s="46">(in this world),</t>

    <t s="49">And through this, the intention of the coming into being of the matters above is completed,</t>

    <t s="54">according to the well-known teaching of the Baal Shem Tov55</t>
    <t s="55">that the coming into being is constantly, at every moment,</t>

    <t s="57">through the service of man.</t>

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Through the Nesi'im explaining that Atik relates to the lower man, additional power is given to each person to connect to Atik and all its levels, including its innermost aspect.

translations.translation: And one may add,

that through this, that the Nesi'im and including the Rebbe, my father-in-law, the Baal HaHilula, wrote and explained the aforementioned matters so that it would be understood that the concept of Atik pertains to the lower man,
behold, through this there is an additional increase in the granting of power to each and every one, that he should have a connection to the concept of Atik,
and to all the levels within it,
until the innermost aspect of Atik.
And particularly according to what is known regarding the Alter Rebbe47,
from this it is understood that so it is with the Nesi'im who came after him,
those who filled his place,
that at the time he spoke or wrote about some matter and level,
behold, not only was he himself in that state at that time,
but he also effected this upon the Chassidim.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The connection of Atik to the lower man is understood through the Maggid's teaching that everything above is from you, meaning the existence above is brought into being through man's service, even regarding Atik and above.

translations.translation: And this)
And this will be understood
(the connection of Atik to the lower man)
based on the teaching of the Maggid48
on the saying of our Sages, of blessed memory49,
"Know what is above you,"
[meaning] that everything that is above, all of it is from you.
And the Alter Rebbe explained50,
that this [idea] that everything that is above, all of it is from you,
is
(not only that through the service of man an addition of light is made,
and the like,
but rather)
that the existence of what is above is brought into being through the service of man.
And behold, from the language of the Maggid "that everything that is above, all of it is from you," it is understood that this applies not only regarding the Sefiros but also regarding Atik
[And furthermore,
since Atik is a primary matter,
behold, regarding Atik this is even more so],
and also regarding the matters that are above Atik.
And the explanation is,
that all the matters above,
their coming into existence is yesh mei'ayin (being from nothing).
And not only the matters after the tzimtzum,
which came into being through the tzimtzum,
but also the matters before the tzimtzum,
even the most sublime lights,
since they are a matter that is not Atzmus,
behold, they came into being from Atzmus.
And in the language of the Rambam51,
that all existent beings
[for in all existent beings are included even the most sublime lights]
came into existence only from the truth of His existence.
For the truth of His existence is Atzmus,
whose existence is from His own essence and is not caused by any cause that preceded Him, Heaven forbid52,
and from Him came into existence
(came into being)
all existent beings.
And the manner of their coming into being from Atzmus is through the service of man.
And the reason for this is,
because all the matters above,
they are in the category of a descent from the light of His countenance53
(and they have no ascent from their own accord),
and the purpose of the descent is in order that there should be the coming into being of this lower world,
than which there is no lower beneath it,
that specifically in it
(in this world),
through the service of man,
the matter of ascent begins.
And through this, the intention of the coming into being of the matters above is completed,
that also in them an ascent is made54.
Therefore,
the coming into being of all the matters above,
that they are constantly coming into being from nothing to something,
according to the well-known teaching of the Baal Shem Tov55
that the coming into being is constantly, at every moment,
is "from you,"
through the service of man.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Based on this, the Tzemach Tzedek's explanation of the verse is understood, that since even supernal Atik is made through man's service, both the aspect of "and to Him" and "not to Him" pertain to man.

translations.translation: a)
And based on this, it will also be understood what the Tzemach Tzedek explains56
on the verse57
"For G-d of knowledge is Havayah, and by Him (v'lo) actions are contrived,"
for the keri (how it is read) is "v'lo" (with a vav),
and the ketiv (how it is written) is "lo" (with an aleph),
for "de'os" (knowledge) is plural, referring to the supernal Da'at and the lower Da'at,
for the lower Da'at has division into Chessed and Gevurah, unlike the supernal Da'at which is above division,
for the supernal Da'at is in Atik, where there is no judgment.
And the matter of "lo" with an aleph and "lo" with a vav is in these two Da'ats.
"V'lo" (with a vav) is in the lower Da'at,
where actions are contrived,
and "lo" (with an aleph) is in the supernal Da'at,
for there actions are not contrived,
for the deeds of man
(actions)
do not pertain there.
And he explains there58,
that in truth, the keri and the ketiv are one.
And one may say the intention in this,
that since even Atik that is above the lines is made through the service of man
(as above),
therefore, also the matter of "and not contrived"
("lo" with an aleph)
pertains to man,
even to the lower man,
and "to him they are contrived"
("v'lo" with a vav).
And one may connect this matter
(the union of the supernal Da'at which is in the category of "not man" with the lower Da'at which is in the category of "man")
with what the Tzemach Tzedek explains there59
in the interpretation of "G-d of knowledge is Havayah,"
that "G-d" [and] "Havayah" join the two Da'ats.
And one may say,
that this is also what the service of man is, included in the three matters of "Turn away60
from evil and do good, seek peace61"
[for since man is in the form of three lines,
therefore his service is also in three lines],
for the two lines of "turn away from evil" and "do good" pertain to the two Da'ats62,
and the service of "seek peace"
[for "peace" is Torah63,
the middle line]
is the union of the two Da'ats,
the union of "not man" with "man."
And also this matter pertains to man,
since it is done through his service.
